name: Armored Trooper VOTOMS
description: The story of stoic Armored Trooper pilot Chirico Cuvie and his quest for answers after a sudden betrayal leaves him on the run from his own military.

credits_cast.character: Phantom Lady Fyana (voice)　※does not appear in all episodes.
credits_cast.name: Kazuko Yanaga

videos.title: The Last Red Shoulder
videos.overview: Chirico Cuvie is reunited with others from the Red Shoulder unit as they pursue their revenge against Yoran Pailsen. Unknown to them, Yoran and his group have created the Perfect Soldier, Ypsilon.

videos.title: Big Battle
videos.overview: Chirico finds his beloved Fiana held hostage by Bararant in an experimental facility near Koba City, and he and his comrades have to fight their way in to save her.

videos.title: Red Shoulder Document - Yabou no Roots
videos.overview: Chirico Cuvie has been assigned to a new unit, the Red Shoulder division. His selection is not an accident, as he has an ability that possibly makes him the ultimate soldier. The Red Shoulder unit is callous and merciless in their training, and will test Chirico's ability to the limit.

videos.title: Brilliantly Shining Heresy: Recurrence
videos.overview: Decades ago, two people took drastic measures to ensure their escape from a galaxy engulfed by war. Unfortunately, the past has finally caught up to them.

videos.title: Brilliantly Shining Heresy: Alegium
videos.overview: Chirico doesn’t care what Titania wants nor that the COMPLANT is falling apart around them. Fyana is the only person who matters and Chirico won’t stop until he gets her back.

videos.title: Brilliantly Shining Heresy: Pilgrimage
videos.overview: Cardinal Montwell uses a recent accomplishment as leverage. Titania seeks out someone intimately familiar with Chirico’s history.

videos.title: Brilliantly Shining Heresy: Critical
videos.overview: The deliberations take a shocking turn with the delivery of unexpected news. Titania finally comes face to face with Fyana.

videos.title: Brilliantly Shining Heresy: The Untouchable
videos.overview: Chirico is coming for Fyana and woe be to anyone who stands in the way. The final confrontation between Chirico and Titania is approaching. Who will be left standing?

videos.title: Pailsen Files: River Crossing Strategy
videos.overview: Chirico Cuvie joins the invasion of a Balarant Union stronghold, but the Balarant defenses are up to the challenge of the assault.

videos.title: Pailsen Files: Galeade
videos.overview: Chirico lands on the planet Galeade, where he meets the members of his new squadron under the command of Barkoff... but for what purpose have they been brought together?

videos.title: Pailsen Files: Squad
videos.overview: A fifth member is added to Barkoff's team, but is he an asset or a liability?

videos.title: Pailsen Files: The Valley of Death
videos.overview: A botched mission leads to disastrous consequences for the Gilgamesh Army.

videos.title: Pailsen Files: Interrogation
videos.overview: Defiant against even insurmountable opposition, Pailsen resists attempts at interrogation, but his silence is no match for the insidious MRC device.

videos.title: Pailsen Files: Abnormal Skills
videos.overview: As the MRC continues its torturous work, Pailsen reveals the truth behind Chirico's seeming invincibility.

videos.title: Pailsen Files: Shooting
videos.overview: Barkoff's team is ordered to a base near the planet's north pole, but a malfunction with their transport plane leaves them unexpectedly stranded.

videos.title: Pailsen Files: Frozen Prison
videos.overview: A new crisis threatens to wipe out the planet's atmosphere, but the changing weather isn't the only threat looming on the horizon...

videos.title: Pailsen Files: Down Burst
videos.overview: With time running out, the team must concoct a PRL formula that can withstand the oncoming extreme cold. Meanwhile, Wappe sets off on a mission of his own.

videos.title: Pailsen Files: Motion Tactics
videos.overview: Wokkam proposes a major attack on Monad, the Balarant fortress-planet, but there is more to this attack than meets the eye.

videos.title: Pailsen Files: Immortal Unit
videos.overview: As Gilgamesh operatives invade Monad, Chirico's origins are at last brought to light.

videos.title: Pailsen Files: Monad
videos.overview: Time is running out as Monad spirals toward destruction. Can Chirico make it out in time, or is his journey fated to end at last?

videos.title: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Pailsen Files The Movie
videos.overview: Set after the 1988 OVA movie Red Shoulder Document: Roots of Ambition and months before the events of the VOTOMS television series, Pailsen Files explores the origins of Chirico Cuvie as explained by the Red Shoulder Battalion's now-disgraced commander, Col Yoran Pailsen. Compilation of the Pailsen Files OAV series.

videos.title: Phantom Arc: Cloud
videos.overview: The more things change, the more they stay the same. Coconna and Vanilla take a trip down memory lane by returning to where their story first began.

videos.title: Phantom Arc: Cumene
videos.overview: Despite Pol’s best efforts, Kummen plunged into war once again. By the time Chirico’s friends arrive, the government has erupted into a full-blown coup d’état.

videos.title: Phantom Arc: Sansa
videos.overview: Zophie once bore a vendetta against Chirico. Now an old woman, she takes in a stranger, but what will she do when she discovers who he really is?

videos.title: Phantom Arc: Nurugeranto
videos.overview: Plots take shape as word spreads about the "Child of God" and people realize the fate of the galaxy is at stake. Chirico must escort the child to the Tower of Gomor.

videos.title: Phantom Arc: Cocoon
videos.overview: Chirico and Shako find themselves deep beneath the surface and in the company of a mysterious girl who warns them about the Doyo.

videos.title: Phantom Arc: Infanti
videos.overview: Forces converge above the planet. Chirico soldiers on, determined to rescue the child entrusted to him, and once again faces an important choice.

videos.title: Alone Again
videos.overview: Chirico meets up with Gotho and friends at an oasis town for the first time in over 30 years.

videos.title: War's End
videos.overview: Chirico Cuvie demands answers when his unit opens fires on their forces during a top-secret mission, but his superior officer stonewalls him. What is going on?

videos.title: Uoodo
videos.overview: Months after the mission that changed his life forever, Chirico hides in the wretched hive known as Uoodo. What recourse does he have when he is enslaved by a local gang?

videos.title: Encounter
videos.overview: Chirico has plans for the ruined Scopedog he found in the junkyard. Will this be the opportunity he needs to turn his luck around?

videos.title: Battling
videos.overview: Recognizing Chirico's expertise as a pilot, Gotho offers him an opportunity to make his fortune in the underground VOTOMS gladiatorial sport known as Battling.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Chirico is caught by powerful people who believe the soldier was sent to Uoodo under orders. As they torture him for information, Chirico's allies plan a rescue mission.

videos.title: Prototype
videos.overview: Reflecting upon the events thus far, Chirico leaves to face the chief of police. His allies plan a daring heist without him.

videos.title: The Raid
videos.overview: Rumors swirl of the police using a city-wide sweep as cover for a mysterious transport. Intrigued, Chirico investigates.

videos.title: The Deal
videos.overview: The crew celebrates, but Chirico wishes no part in the spoils. While the police react, another player watches from the shadows.

videos.title: The Rescue
videos.overview: Chirico faces the wrath of the police alone. Enraged, Coconna demands that the crew return to help their friend.

videos.title: Red Shoulder
videos.overview: The police adopt a scorched earth policy in their attempts to flush Chirico and his allies out. Forced to run, the four take drastic measures to save their own lives.

videos.title: Counterattack
videos.overview: The Prototype defies a direct order to engage Chirico in combat. The police chief and Borough attempt to discover why while the AT pilot dominates the battle.

videos.title: Bonds
videos.overview: Chirico and the Prototype are discussing their situation when the police discover their location. Borough proposes that Battling pilots chase after them.

videos.title: Escape
videos.overview: The military occupies Uoodo and demands the surrender of police forces. Chief Iskui is ordered by his superior to buy time so the Prototype can be smuggled out of the city.

videos.title: Assemble EX-10
videos.overview: Three months after the events on Uoodo, a new chapter unfolds as Chirico finds himself on the front lines as a mercenary in the war-torn kingdom of Kummen.

videos.title: Doubts
videos.overview: Captain Kan Yu's assistance arrives just in time and Chirico is questioned for his battlefield decision. A PS is a deadly opponent, so what are their options when facing one?

videos.title: Clean Sweep
videos.overview: The mercenaries fend off a guerrilla raid, but Pol is shocked when he recognizes one of the attackers. Chirico discovers Pol's connection to the Kummen army.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Chirico miscalculated, and the enemy was not who he thought it was. Despite this, he's still determined to find answers, and the two soldiers clash.

videos.title: Tournabout
videos.overview: Chirico's been found, but his miraculous survival causes the suspicious Captain Kan Yu to accuse him of switching sides and demands his interrogation.

videos.title: Intentions
videos.overview: A Melkian officer plans to inspect the front lines when the Veela unleash their assault on EX-10 and Niitan. Vanilla refuses to abandon the club despite Coconna's urging.

videos.title: Fyana
videos.overview: Chirico reflects upon his previous adventure and the events that led to his reunion with Fyana in Uoodo.

videos.title: Upriver
videos.overview: Chirico is put in charge of an operation against enemy headquarters. Kan Yu objects, believing he should be in command instead.

videos.title: Contact Blast
videos.overview: Kan Yu is criticized for his actions and ordered to follow a new strategy as everyone's plans seemingly depend on Chirico.

videos.title: Complications
videos.overview: Fyana seizes an opportunity and flees into the jungle. An injured Borough is enraged when he realizes that Ypsilon has gone after her and orders the unthinkable.

videos.title: Intersection
videos.overview: Loyalties are tested after Chirico rewards his friends with the truth after they save both him and Fyana from an ambush.

videos.title: Infiltration
videos.overview: A man left for dead refuses to die, despite everything the jungle throws at him. Meanwhile, Chirico's group plans their assault.

videos.title: Closing In
videos.overview: Vanilla must join a massive assault, despite Gotho and Coconna's concerns. With the forces converging on the palace, is the war finally coming to an end?

videos.title: Dark Change
videos.overview: Three figures muse over the status of the war as fighting rages on the planet below. Chirico confronts Borough and demands answers regarding the PS.

videos.title: Destiny
videos.overview: Before the next adventure begins, Chirico recalls painful memories of his past exploits in Uoodo.

videos.title: Two People
videos.overview: Chirico and Fyana may have escaped Kummen, but they now find themselves in an undisclosed and seemingly abandoned location. For what purpose are they there?

videos.title: Phantasm
videos.overview: Chirico and Fyana attempt to thwart their attackers, but they are too numerous. Does the enemy have good reasons for its actions?

videos.title: Nonaggression Zone
videos.overview: The captain is done playing and vows to capture Chirico and Fyana. A distraction is all it takes for Chirico's AT to suffer critical damage.

videos.title: Ypsilon
videos.overview: Chirico's condition deteriorates, and Fyana must take drastic measures if she wishes to save him.

videos.title: Showdown
videos.overview: Chirico and Fyana fight at a disadvantage against Ypsilon. How will they turn the tide when Ypsilon's hatred for Chirico drives him to a single-minded purpose?

videos.title: Planet Sunsa
videos.overview: A brawl with a scavenger gang leads to a reunion with an old friend. Meanwhile, a captain must decide whether to continue a mission or pursue Chirico.

videos.title: Deadline
videos.overview: The ATs stare each other down in grim anticipation of the coming battle. When the Balarant suddenly attack, everyone must scramble for their lives.

videos.title: Love and Hate
videos.overview: The trio is alone in the desert and low on oxygen. Zophie has not forgotten, nor has she forgiven. But to survive, she may need Chirico's assistance regardless.

videos.title: Captives
videos.overview: Repairs on the AT continue, but the Balarant forces are quickly approaching. Chirico wants his friends to save themselves, but they have other plans.

videos.title: Darkness
videos.overview: Ypsilon and Chirico are destined to fight over and over. But when they are both trapped by debris, can Ypsilon set aside his hatred in the interest of mutual survival?

videos.title: Perfect Soldier
videos.overview: With the immediate danger behind them, Chirico and Ypsilon prepare for their sworn rematch. Will they finally be able to settle things once and for all?

videos.title: Friends
videos.overview: Time is a flat circle. Chirico remembers how he escaped from Kummen alongside Fyana, only to end up on a mysterious warship.

videos.title: Quent
videos.overview: With his ship crashed, Chirico has no choice but to venture into the hostile deserts of Quent if he wishes to continue his mission.

videos.title: The Desert
videos.overview: The Society no longer underestimates Chirico and considers him a legitimate threat. Meanwhile, Chirico and Shako must brave the desert on their travels.

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: The twins decide to make planetfall. Meanwhile, Chirico requests entrance to the Quentman village.

videos.title: The Forbidden
videos.overview: There can be no more room for doubt in the Society's mind: Quent contains a trove of advanced technology. What will be their next move after this discovery?

videos.title: Encounter
videos.overview: The events on Quent captures the attention of another party, which deploys its forces in response. Chirico and Shako explore the ruins beneath the planet's surface.

videos.title: Premonition
videos.overview: As Gilgamesh and Balarant forces prepare for battle, the Society wonders how they can use this to their advantage. Unless something changes, Quent will turn into a warzone.

videos.title: Disaster
videos.overview: The battle rages over the planet. To the victor goes Quent's secrets. Chirico's friends escape in a stolen Gilgamesh ship but are quickly intercepted by the Balarant.

videos.title: Successor
videos.overview: Onboard a ship not under their control, its passengers can only wait as it ventures closer to an object that is clearly no moon. What awaits all of them inside?

videos.title: Overman
videos.overview: A 3,000-year-old truth unites the warring Gilgamesh and Balarant into a single, vengeful army. Meanwhile, what are the implications for Wiseman's plans with Chirico?

videos.title: Storm Clouds
videos.overview: A failed mutiny solidifies Chirico's control. The joint Gilgamesh/Balarant fleet devises ways to fight Wiseman. As forces converge, a question burns: How can one stop a god?

videos.title: Carnage
videos.overview: History is filled with men who sacrificed everything in pursuit of power. Fyana refuses to let her love be one of them. Is Chirico truly willing to make everyone his enemy?

videos.title: Shooting Star
videos.overview: The road was long and hard-fought but in the end, a choice will be made. That choice will determine the fate of the entire galaxy.
